firm_data.firm_description: Seward & Kissel LLP is a leading U.S. law firm that focuses on corporate and litigation work for clients seeking legal expertise in the financial services, corporate finance, and capital markets areas. The Firm is particularly well known for its representation of major commercial banks, investment banking firms, investment advisers and related investment funds.
notable_facts: Offices in New York City and Washington, D.C.
Focuses on representing clients in financial services, corporate finance and capital markets

email.subject: AI for Seward & Kissel LLP, built for capital markets practices
email.body:
Hi James,

With Seward & Kissel's deep bench in capital markets and financial services, you're handling some of the most document-intensive work in the industry. Your team knows the precision and client trust these practices demand.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding our footprint. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on document-heavy matters.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
